topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's learning outcomes, historical tumor progression models, and the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt signaling cascades drive autonomous cellular proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired terminal differentiation prevents cells from exiting the cell cycle across leukemias and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells resist programmed cell death through mutations disrupting p53 signaling and the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic factors.

topics.label: Replicative immortalization, telomeres, and senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain telomere shortening, TERT reactivation mechanisms, and p53-dependent senescence arrest before concluding the growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Altered cellular metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore cancer metabolic rewiring, including aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific profiles, and oncometabolite-generating mutations.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vasculature induction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the angiogenic switch and the molecular balance required for tumors to stimulate new blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and genomics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the systemic dissemination of cancer cells, metastatic inefficiency under the seed and soil model, and genomic features such as whole genome duplication.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture by framing the overall hallmark model and providing recommended literature.
